name: WPSC Sheboygan-Plymouth Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 529: WPSC Sheboygan/Plymouth Lateral, Wisconsin Public Service Corp, completed 2008-10-01, WI to WI, 30 million USD, 32 mi, diameters 12 and 16 in, intrastate, authority State. No match in the GEM roster (checked all Wisconsin rows and name search). Single source: no FERC filing exists (intrastate); the Wisconsin PSC docket and a utility release were searched and not found. The 2020 DATCP Plymouth-to-Chilton project is a different line. Meets length rule (32 mi, above 15.5 mi). Start and end points are the project name only, with no coordinates; location refs not claimed. Diameter 12 and 16 in as listed, not split by segment. Owner entity matches the ownership gazetteer exactly (E100000004338). Tier medium: one dated source, no state regulator corroboration. Route not found.
